content.title: About Tap to Tool
content.subtitle: Simple tools for big ideas.
content.description_p1: Tap to Tool was born from the need for quick and straightforward solutions for daily digital tasks. We believe you shouldn't have to deal with heavy websites, invasive ads, or unnecessary registrations just to perform simple tasks like formatting text, generating data, or converting files.
content.description_p2: Our mission is to be your digital Swiss Army knife: a utility hub designed to offer precision, speed, and ease of use.

principles.label: Performance
principles.text: Our tools are lightweight and load instantly, keeping your workflow continuous.

principles.label: Privacy
principles.text: We prioritize local processing (client-side). Most of what you process here stays in your browser and never touches our servers.

principles.label: Accessibility
principles.text: A clean and functional design, available on any device, anywhere in the world, for free.

content.footer_text: Whether you're a developer, content creator, or anyone seeking more productivity, Tap to Tool is here to ensure you have exactly what you need, when you need it.
